Players Committee card image of [[Agent Kallus (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and place the other in Used Pile. While with an ISB agent, adds one battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/agentkallus_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 83cacba] (19 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
